purpose: Extend a phenomenon beyond its initial range.
keywords: N / plain clause + にとどまらず
The impact extended beyond the country to overseas.
His work extends beyond writing into education.
Damage affected not just houses but farmland too.
formation: N / plain clause + にとどまらず
restrictions: The second clause expands scope, effect, or degree.
mistake: It does not mean physically staying in one place here.
